_comment: CLOSED search, max_fragment_charge=1. This is the config behind the +1.1% IH2 / +0.35% small-file
result, and it was previously measured from a TEMP config on the cluster and never committed --
so the win was real but not reproducible by anyone reading this repo.
Restricting Sage to singly-charged fragments HELPS us (+1.1%) and HURTS the reference implementation (-2.3%). The
opposite signs mean the gain is ours rather than generic search tuning: what we scored as 2+
fragments was predominantly noise the extra charge hypothesis could fit.
The fasta path is rewritten at run time; everything else is fixed.
